Get differential metabolites with log fold-changes and adjusted pvalues based on input comparison groups

DiffMetabolites.Rd

Fits model on the full input dataset with limma

Usage

DiffMetabolites(
  cleanData,
  groups = NULL,
  contrastLevel = "Group",
  repeated_measures = "no"
)

Arguments

cleanData

The QC'd and imputed data.frame

groups

Vector of groups names to contrast. Defaults to the unique elements of the Group column but the column used can be specified using contrastLevel.

contrastLevel

The column from the data containing groups levels, usually "Group".

repeated_measures

Were there repeated measures?

Value

LogFC and adjusted P-values of limma::topTable() for each contrast
